title: RentSafeTO Building Health Scorecard: 25 wards x 8 pillars
design_credit: Layout inspired by the WEF TTDI table; no TTDI scores are reproduced.

columns.label: Building systems
items: Interior Lobby and Hallway Lighting Levels

columns.label: Paperwork & tenant communication
items: State of Good Repair Plan (Capital Plan)

method.unit: Each building's LATEST post-2023 evaluation (the RSN panel is collapsed to the latest row by completion date).
method.overall: Overall = the City's CURRENT BUILDING EVAL SCORE (proactive score plus current reactive deductions), which is what sets the lobby sign colour. Not recomputed.
method.pillar: Pillar % for one building = sum(w_i x s_i / 3) / sum(w_i) x 100 over the pillar's items scored 1-3, with the City's published tier weights (High 3, Moderate 2, Cosmetic 0.5). N/A items are left out. Provisional choice, to be confirmed: items scored 0 (an area refused or blocked) are also left out and counted in the refusal columns instead; the *_mean_city_basis fields count them as 0 points, which is what the City's own score does (see analysis A).
method.ward_cell: Ward cell (default) = simple mean over the ward's buildings, each building counted once (*_mean). The unit-weighted mean (*_unit_weighted, weights = CONFIRMED UNITS) and the building count (*_n) are also given.
method.district_and_city_rows: District and City rows: the default (*__avg_of_wards) is the SIMPLE AVERAGE OF THE MEMBER WARD CELLS, each ward counted once, like a regional-average row in the TTDI table. The pooled mean over all the buildings in the district or city (*__pooled_buildings) is also given; the two differ because wards hold different numbers of buildings.
method.bands: Colour bands are the City's lobby-sign bands: 85-100 green, 70-84 yellow, 0-69 red.
method.pct_band: pct_green/yellow/red = share of the ward's buildings whose latest City score is in the band.
method.refusals: refusal_evals_per_100 = latest evaluations with at least one item scored 0 per 100 evaluations; refused_items_per_100_evals = items scored 0 per 100 evaluations.
method.rank: rank = 1 + number of wards with a higher overall_mean (ties share a rank); *_rank the same per pillar on *_mean.
method.low_n: low_n is true when a ward has fewer than 5 buildings.

limits: The 8-pillar grouping is ours; the City publishes items and tiers, not pillars.
Scores are the City's bylaw-evaluation scores, not a safety rating; a red sign does not mean unsafe.
Latest evaluations span several years (2023-2026), so wards are compared across slightly different dates.
Provisional choice, to be confirmed: a refused area is kept as a separate flag here; the City's own score counts it as zero points.
Public view is ward/district level only; no landlord, firm or address is ranked.
